title: Once MettleUp Plus is on, a gym owner can give friends every paid feature free by listing them as staff
what: Phone number sign-in treats anyone on a gym's staff list as gym staff, and gym staff get every paid feature free. Nothing checks that the person really works there. An owner can list up to 30 friends as desk staff, let each sign in once, then remove them and list the next 30. Because the phone never checks the staff note again, each friend keeps Plus free after being removed.
expected: Free Plus for staff is checked against the gym's live staff list from time to time, and a gym cannot hand out more free Plus places than it has real staff.
how_often: only when an owner chooses to abuse it, and only once Plus is switched on
fix_line: Recheck the staff list when the app opens and drop free Plus when the number is no longer staff
